extraction.name: WikiText
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for language modeling constructed using text extracted from Good and Featured articles on Wikipedia. It is available in two sizes, WikiText-2 and WikiText-103, and features punctuation, original casing, a larger vocabulary, and numbers.
extraction.creator: Stephen Merity; Caiming Xiong; James Bradbury; Richard Socher
extraction.citeAs: Stephen Merity, Caiming Xiong, James Bradbury, Richard Socher. Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models. 2016.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Text for each article was extracted using the Wikipedia API, selecting only articles fitting the Good or Featured article criteria specified by editors on Wikipedia.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw text from Wikipedia mark-up for articles meeting the Good or Featured article criteria.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: language modeling; improve handling of rare words and the usage of long term dependencies in language modeling
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Specific sections which primarily featured lists were removed by default. Other minor bugs, such as sort keys and Edit buttons that leaked in from the HTML, were also removed. Mathematical formulae and LATEX code, were replaced with <formula> tokens. Normalization and tokenization were performed using the Moses tokenizer, slightly augmented to further split numbers... a vocabulary was constructed by discarding all words with a count below 3. Words outside of the vocabulary were mapped to the <unk> token.
